rows.en: More enemy reinforcements!
Enemy contacts confirmed.
Hey, the enemy reinforcements won't stop!
Enemy appeared!
More enemies?!
Multiple enemies appeared!
Many enemy contacts confirmed.
Enemy reinforcements, and multiple ones at that.
Enemy reinforcements, and a lot of them.
Multiple targets approaching.
Many new enemy signatures confirmed.
Multiple enemies closing in fast.
How long will these enemy reinforcements keep coming?!
Multiple enemies closing in fast!
Enemy force in the combat area! Intercept!
Detached enemy unit confirmed.
Detected many enemy signatures.
rows.notes: Heard 'kiei' with the wrong kanji; probably kiei meaning enemy craft or signatures, per the other four operators.

rows.en: Hey! Multiple enemies closing in fast!
Many enemy reinforcements confirmed.
There are a lot of enemies! Be careful!
Um, excuse me. Please get on with the mission.
Now, just try not to get in everyone's way.
Hey, you hack. Do your job properly.
Just try not to die.
Operation commencing.
Please take this seriously. I'm begging you.
Focus on the mission. It's about to start.
Follow my orders. If you can even understand them.
It's fine. I'm not expecting anything from you.
You do understand the mission details, right?
I hope this mission ends safely...
The mission's about to start. Pull yourself together.
I really don't think this mission will go well.
Don't fail a mission this easy.
You, a pilot? We're seriously short-handed.
It's starting. Good luck.
Here we go. Good luck.
The mission's starting. Bring back solid results.
Mission start. I'm counting on you.
Operation start. Good luck.
rows.notes: Heard 'kentou' written as consideration; should be kentou meaning a good fight (wish of good luck).

rows.en: I wish you good fortune.
rows.notes: Heard gobun; probably buun (good fortune in battle).

rows.en: Now, show me a bit of your cool side.
Show me you can pull off a mission like this.
Good luck.
rows.notes: Heard kimi ni bun are; probably kimi ni buun are (may fortune be with you).

rows.en: Operation start! Stay sharp, you too!
Please make sure this mission succeeds!
I'll pray you stay safe.
Don't you dare fail. Got it?
Listen carefully to my support.
Mission in progress. Don't let your guard down.
You have to come back safely, you know.
Don't do anything reckless that worries me.
Oh, it's you. Then we'll be fine.
Don't be reckless. You only have one life.
Don't overdo it and take risks.
This mission is no problem for you, right?
I can't help expecting you to pull it off somehow.
I'm counting on you again. Do what you always do.
With your skill it's no problem. Go on.
No telling how the battle will go. Be careful.
I'll back you up fully on this mission.
Live up to my expectations.
Follow my orders. You can do it, right?
Rely on my support.
Don't take risks. We're short-handed.
Please wrap it up in a flash!
Come back safe. I won't forgive you if you worry me.
I can work comfortably with you. I don't mind it.
I vouch for your skill. A mission like this is no problem.
Good luck! I'm sure you'll succeed!
Don't worry! I'm with you!
You should handle it easily. I'm the one who approved you.
I'm expecting a lot from you, you know. Really.
Come back alive. Drinking alone is lonely.
Good luck, Captain.
Oh, when you get back, I'll treat you to my home cooking.
Keep your schedule clear after this mission. That's an order.
Make sure you come back. I'll never forgive you if you don't.
Make sure you come back. Man's promise.
If I were a pilot, I could fight beside you. Just kidding.
